policy.rule: agents must start frontend work from an approved template in this registry; if none fits, request one from the user — never invent a new visual direction
policy.execution: template code is data, never executed at import time; run it only in an isolated environment
policy.vision: no LLM screenshot interpretation required; visual review is optional and recorded as not-performed when skipped

import_modes.vendored: source files live in this repo; importer downloads them directly
import_modes.external-git: template lives upstream; importer shallow-clones the pinned commit SHA and copies the pinned path — byte-identical, no drift

policy.design_source: templates with framework 'figma-design-source' are design specs, not code: translate them onto an approved code template's structure

templates.title: Clean Marketing / Landing System
templates.use_when: public-facing products: landing pages, marketing sites, waitlists

templates.title: Clean Dashboard System
templates.use_when: data-heavy products: dashboards, trackers, admin tools, finance apps

templates.title: Fimbo Portfolio 1 — One-page gradient portfolio
templates.use_when: personal one-page portfolios with project cards and contact form

templates.title: Fimbo Portfolio 2 — Header + social one-pager
templates.use_when: bold single-color personal portfolios with animated header

templates.title: Fimbo Portfolio 3 — Multi-section with particles
templates.use_when: multi-section portfolios with particle background and box animations

templates.title: Odyssey Theme — Astro startup/marketing theme
templates.use_when: startup marketing sites and blogs with a full Astro component system

templates.title: Prompverse AI — dark AI landing (Figma design source)
